title: Which Rules Matter Now? Policy-Centroid Routing Before an Intelligent System Acts
abstract: arXiv:2608.30757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before an intelligent system can decide whether an action is allowed, it must first know which rules the action has approached. A single proposed action can implicate several policy regimes at once. Their requirements may stack, overlap, or qualify one another, yet many remain written in natural language while the action itself arrives as an incomplete description of intent. The first problem is not judgment. It is attention.   Policy-centroid routing creates a layer before adjudication. It compresses expressions within each policy regime into one or more representative centroids, places the proposed action in the same semantic space, applies a declared measure, and routes every regime crossing a declared threshold to authoritative review. Several regimes may trigger at once. The output is a review agenda, not permission, prohibition, legality, breach, compliance, certification, or enforcement. translated_title: 哪些规则现在重要？智能系统行动前的策略质心路由
translated_abstract: 在智能系统能够决定某个动作是否被允许之前，它必须首先知道该动作接近了哪些规则。单个提议的动作可能同时涉及多个政策体系，这些体系的要求可能相互叠加、重叠或相互限定，然而许多规则仍以自然语言书写，而动作本身则以不完整的意图描述形式出现。首要问题不是判断，而是注意力。策略质心路由在裁决之前创建了一个层级：它将每个政策体系内的表达式压缩为一个或多个代表性质心，将提议的动作置于相同的语义空间中，应用声明的度量方式，并将每个超过声明阈值的体系路由到权威审查。多个体系可能同时触发。其输出是一个审查议程，而非许可、禁止、合法性、违规、合规、认证或执行。该论文提出了六个可证伪的命题……
tldr: 该论文提出“策略质心路由”机制，在智能系统进行裁决之前，将各政策体系的规则压缩为语义质心，通过阈值筛选识别出与提议动作相关的所有政策体系，并生成审查议程而非直接判断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a policy-centroid routing mechanism that, before an intelligent system adjudicates an action, compresses rules within each policy regime into semantic centroids, routes all regimes exceeding a declared threshold to authoritative review, and outputs a review agenda rather than a judgment.
